name: Assembled iron-plate form
summary: In Bi Sheng's method, fired clay characters were set in an iron frame on a coated iron plate, warmed and pressed level to form a printing surface.
description: Fired types composed within a frame on a coated iron plate, warmed and leveled.
tier_reason: Demote the framed assembly to fine detail while retaining its separate component/assembly role. This is a scoped consequence judgement, not a reward for documentation or representation.
